skills.name: A股财报法证分析
skills.summary: 围绕A股单家公司最近五年报表评估盈利质量、财务健康、舞弊风险和营运效率；重点读附注、扣非利润、关联交易、政府补助、商誉及在建工程。
skills.author: FinoGeeks Technology Ltd
skills.environment: Claude Skills 格式；仓库按 Claude Skills 组织，其他宿主未实测。
dependencies: 需年报、半年报、季报和附注；可选调用同仓 A 股 FinData Toolkit。分析技能未声明独立 Python 依赖。
inputs: 股票代码或名称；默认近5年/20个季度；关注领域；2–3家可比公司；披露文件。
outputs: 5年杜邦分解、盈利质量和Z/F/M评分；营运资本与资产负债表风险；分部及同行比较报告。
skills.example: 以A股公司年报和附注检查贵州茅台近5年现金转化、合同负债、商誉、关联交易和扣非利润。
skills.method: 以五因子杜邦分解追踪ROE；结合应计率、经营现金流/净利润、收入与应收增速、Z/F/M评分和现金转换周期，检查A股常见会计及治理风险。
skills.notes: 仅作分析性审阅，不是审计，也不替代估值或买卖判断。市场数据工具包声明使用免费数据源、无需API密钥；数据准确性仍需回到披露文件核对。
evidenceQuotes: A股使用企业会计准则（CAS），与US GAAP有差异。
政府补助依赖 | 政府补助占净利润比例 | > 30%（利润可持续性存疑）
skills.summaryEn: Reviews up to five years of one A-share issuer’s financial statements for earnings quality, financial health, manipulation indicators and operating efficiency, with attention to notes, adjusted profit, related parties, subsidies, goodwill and construction in progress.
skills.methodEn: Track ROE with a five-factor DuPont decomposition. Combine accruals, operating cash conversion, revenue-versus-receivables growth, Z/F/M scores and the cash conversion cycle, then review China-specific accounting and governance risks.
skills.environmentEn: Claude Skills format; organized for Claude Skills. Other hosts have not been tested.
dependenciesEn: Annual, interim and quarterly reports plus notes; the companion China FinData Toolkit is optional. No separate Python dependency is declared for this analysis skill.
inputsEn: Ticker or company name; default five-year/20-quarter period; focus area; optional 2–3 peers; filings.
outputsEn: Five-year DuPont, earnings-quality and Z/F/M review; working-capital and balance-sheet risks; segment and peer comparison.
skills.exampleEn: Review five years of Kweichow Moutai filings for cash conversion, contract liabilities, goodwill, related-party transactions and adjusted profit.
skills.notesEn: An analytical review, not an audit or a buy/sell conclusion. The companion toolkit describes its data sources as free and keyless; verify metrics against filings.

skills.name: A股低估值基本面筛选
skills.summary: 按申万行业相对估值和基本面质量扫描A股候选公司；使用扣非利润、正自由现金流、行业中位数及ST/上市年限排除项降低价值陷阱。
skills.author: FinoGeeks Technology Ltd
skills.environment: Claude Skills 格式；其他宿主未实测。
dependencies: 需要当前A股价格及财务数据；可选用同仓 A 股 FinData Toolkit，无需API密钥。
inputs: 市场/申万行业/板块或自定义池；市值区间；返回数量；价值、成长或红利侧重。
outputs: 筛选条件表、候选股票画像、低估原因、风险和估值区间。
skills.example: 筛选申万家电行业，返回不超过10家满足现金流、扣非增长和行业相对估值条件的公司，并逐项列出排除原因。
skills.method: 先按行业中位数筛PE/PB，再检查3–5年收入和归母净利润增长、杠杆、自由现金流及ROE/ROIC；对通过者解释折价原因、风险和估值区间。
skills.notes: 使用行业内相对估值；银行破净、ST、次新股和非经常性损益需要专门处理。“便宜”不等于值得买。
evidenceQuotes: PE估值 | 滚动PE低于所属申万行业中位数
**自动排除**：ST/\*ST公司、上市不满2年的公司、近12个月净利润为负的公司。
skills.summaryEn: Screens A-shares using valuation relative to Shenwan industry medians and fundamental quality filters. It uses adjusted profit, positive free cash flow, listing-age and ST exclusions to reduce value-trap candidates.
skills.methodEn: Screen P/E and P/B against industry medians, then check three-to-five-year revenue and attributable-profit growth, leverage, free cash flow and ROE/ROIC. For passers, explain the discount, risks and valuation range.
skills.environmentEn: Claude Skills format; compatibility with other hosts has not been tested.
dependenciesEn: Requires current A-share prices and financials. The companion China FinData Toolkit is optional and is described as keyless.
inputsEn: Market, Shenwan industry, board or custom universe; market-cap range; result count; value, growth or dividend emphasis.
outputsEn: Filter table; candidate profiles; discount rationale; risks and valuation ranges.
skills.exampleEn: Screen Shenwan household appliances for up to ten companies meeting cash-flow, adjusted-growth and relative-valuation conditions, and state why each failed name was excluded.
skills.notesEn: Uses China-specific industry and listing filters. Banks and other sectors need specialized metrics; a low multiple alone is not a buy signal.

skills.name: A股宏观与行业轮动
skills.summary: 以中国宏观数据、政策方向和申万行业分类判断未来6–12个月的相对行业表现，并为每个观点写出概率、风险和可观察的失效条件。
skills.author: FinoGeeks Technology Ltd
skills.environment: Claude Skills 格式；其他宿主未实测。
dependencies: 需要联网核验宏观、政策和行业数据；可选同仓 A 股 FinData Toolkit，无需API密钥。
inputs: A股/港股通/中概范围；期限；申万一/二/三级行业；现有配置；风险偏好。
outputs: 五大宏观支柱仪表盘、周期定位、行业超配/标配/低配表、风险和失效条件。
skills.example: 判断A股未来6–12个月行业相对机会，分别标明社融趋势、政策催化、周期位置和观点反转阈值。
skills.method: 评估LPR/MLF与社融、CPI/PPI、GDP/PMI、就业消费及政策导向；映射复苏、扩张、滞胀或衰退阶段，再给出相对沪深300的行业信号。
skills.notes: 宏观预测应以概率表达；房地产业链和政策主题可能改变历史行业轮动关系。
evidenceQuotes: 社会融资规模增速是A股最重要的领先指标
中国经济的政策驱动性远强于西方市场
skills.summaryEn: Uses China macro data, policy direction and Shenwan sectors to assess relative performance over the next 6–12 months. Each view includes probability, risk and an observable invalidation trigger.
skills.methodEn: Assess LPR/MLF and aggregate financing, CPI/PPI, GDP/PMIs, employment and consumption, and policy direction. Map conditions to a cycle phase and express sector views relative to the CSI 300.
skills.environmentEn: Claude Skills format; compatibility with other hosts has not been tested.
dependenciesEn: Requires current web-researched macro, policy and sector data; the companion China toolkit is optional and keyless.
inputsEn: A-share, Stock Connect or Chinese ADR scope; horizon; Shenwan level-1/2/3 sectors; current exposures; risk tolerance.
outputsEn: Five-pillar macro dashboard; cycle phase; sector overweight/neutral/underweight table; risks and invalidation triggers.
skills.exampleEn: Assess A-share sector prospects for the next 6–12 months, showing financing trends, policy catalysts, cycle position and reversal thresholds.
skills.notesEn: Macro forecasts should be probabilistic. Property-chain effects and policy themes can disrupt historical rotation patterns.

skills.name: A股多因子选股与拥挤度
skills.summary: 用价值、动量、质量、低波动、规模和成长六类因子对A股股票池打分，并叠加宏观择时、行业中性和拥挤度检查。
skills.author: FinoGeeks Technology Ltd
skills.environment: Claude Skills 格式；其他宿主未实测。
dependencies: 需行情、财务和宏观数据；可选同仓 A 股 FinData Toolkit。现实回测需另备历史数据和研究/回测环境，技能未声明代码包。
inputs: 股票池（默认中证800）；因子及权重；行业约束；选股数量；排除项；宏观阶段。
outputs: 因子得分及排名、因子暴露、行业分布、拥挤度面板、回撤风险。
skills.example: 对中证800按六因子等权并做行业中性排名，输出前20名及因子拥挤、换手成本和可能失效情景。
skills.method: 将各因子指标转为股票池或行业内百分位，按权重合成；结合宏观周期调整暴露，并检查估值价差、因子相关性、基金流入及市场拥挤。
skills.notes: A股小盘与换手率因子可能受壳价值、流动性和印花税影响；需纳入实际交易成本，不构成个人化建议。
evidenceQuotes: 将排名转换为百分位得分（0–100）
- **交易成本**：动量策略换手率高。需考虑现实的交易成本（印花税0.05%+佣金）。
skills.summaryEn: Scores A-shares on value, momentum, quality, low volatility, size and growth, with macro timing, industry neutrality and factor-crowding checks.
skills.methodEn: Convert metrics into within-universe or within-industry percentile ranks, combine them using explicit weights, adjust factor exposure for the macro phase, and inspect valuation spreads, correlations, fund flows and crowding.
skills.environmentEn: Claude Skills format; compatibility with other hosts has not been tested.
dependenciesEn: Requires price, financial and macro data. A practical backtest also needs historical data and a research/backtesting environment; the skill declares no bundled code package.
inputsEn: Universe (CSI 800 by default); factors and weights; industry constraints; number of names; exclusions; macro phase.
outputsEn: Factor scores and ranks; exposures and sector distribution; crowding panel; drawdown risks.
skills.exampleEn: Rank the CSI 800 using six equally weighted factors with industry neutrality and report the top 20, crowding, turnover costs and failure scenarios.
skills.notesEn: A-share size and turnover effects can reflect shell value and liquidity. Include stamp duty and commissions; this is not personalized advice.

skills.name: A股高股息可持续性分析

skills.environment: Claude Skills 格式；其他宿主未实测。

skills.notes: 来源提示A股通常年度分红且持有期影响个人股息税；需核实适用税制和公司公告，不能用送股替代现金股息。

自由现金流覆盖分红 ≥ 1.3倍
skills.summaryEn: Evaluates A-share cash-dividend return, growth and sustainability, distinguishing a high yield from a sustainable payout and accounting for payout frequency, tax and free-cash-flow coverage.

dependencies: 无脚本或API依赖声明；真实验证需历史数据、回测环境、成本/容量估计和防止数据泄漏的流程。建议连同invest.md打包。
inputs: 策略假设；股票池；持有期；可用数据；交易成本、容量及回测时期。
outputs: 信号定义、样本外验证计划、多信号组合、执行成本、模型风险和研究/模拟/部署阶段判断。
skills.example: 评估一个动量因子：定义可观察特征、股票池、持有期和费用，跨市场阶段样本外检验，再评估衰减和成交容量。
skills.method: 把假设变为可测信号，定义股票池/期限/成本/数据可得性，做跨周期样本外测试；组合多种弱信号并跟踪衰减。
skills.notes: 这是仓库整理的量化研究风格框架，不代表Jim Simons/Renaissance的真实策略。不得以样本内回测作为部署证据；排查前视和泄漏。
evidenceQuotes: Test out-of-sample and across regimes.
Do not deploy before data leakage checks.
skills.summaryEn: Turns a trading hypothesis into measurable signals, requires out-of-sample validation across regimes, combines several weak edges and accounts for slippage, capacity, turnover and decay.
skills.methodEn: Define the universe, holding period, costs and available data; test out of sample across regimes; combine weak signals; model execution and monitor decay.
skills.environmentEn: Requires a host that can read SKILL.md and the companion invest.md; host compatibility was not tested.
dependenciesEn: A curated quant-research framework, not a disclosure of Jim Simons or Renaissance strategies. Requires historical data, a backtest environment, cost/capacity estimates and leakage controls. Package invest.md with the skill.
inputsEn: Strategy hypothesis; universe; holding period; available data; costs, capacity and test periods.
outputsEn: Signal definitions; out-of-sample validation plan; multi-signal portfolio; execution costs; model risks; research/paper/deploy stage.
skills.exampleEn: Evaluate a momentum factor by defining features, universe, holding period and costs, validating across regimes out of sample, and assessing decay and capacity.
skills.notesEn: A stylized framework curated by Questflow/Bob Xu, not an official skill published or endorsed by the named investor. Verify claims against primary sources.

skills.name: 久期、曲线与信用相对价值
skills.summary: 从利率与通胀制度出发拆解久期、收益率曲线、信用和流动性风险，再比较风险补偿而非追逐最高票息。
skills.author: Bob Xu
skills.environment: SKILL.md引用同目录invest.md；需适配目标债券市场。
dependencies: 无脚本或API依赖声明；需要利率/通胀预期、收益率曲线、信用利差、久期、违约及流动性数据。建议连同invest.md打包。
inputs: 债券或组合；期限和权重；曲线、利率和通胀环境；信用与流动性约束。
outputs: 利率制度判断、久期/曲线/信用敞口、风险补偿比较、组合选择和失效条件。
skills.example: 比较同期限国债和高收益信用债：列出收益、久期、违约、流动性及凸性补偿，说明何种变化会推翻配置判断。
skills.method: 界定利率和通胀路径；拆分久期、曲线和信用敞口；比较收益与久期、违约、流动性、凸性风险的补偿。
skills.notes: 由Questflow/Bob Xu整理的风格化判断框架；不是相关投资者本人发布或背书的官方技能，个别方法应回到原始资料核验。
evidenceQuotes: Compare yield to risk: duration, default, liquidity, convexity.
Choose instruments with best compensation, not highest headline yield.
skills.nameEn: Fixed-income relative value: duration, curve and credit
skills.summaryEn: Starts with the rates and inflation regime, decomposes duration, curve, credit and liquidity exposures, then compares risk compensation instead of chasing the highest coupon.
skills.methodEn: Define the rates/inflation regime; map duration, curve and credit; compare yield with duration, default, liquidity and convexity risks.
skills.environmentEn: Requires a host that can read SKILL.md and the companion invest.md; host compatibility was not tested.
dependenciesEn: No script or API dependency is declared. Needs rates/inflation expectations, yield curves, spreads, duration, default and liquidity data. Adapt the framework to the target bond market and package invest.md.
inputsEn: Bond or portfolio; horizon and weights; rates/curve/inflation context; credit and liquidity limits.
outputsEn: Rates-regime view; duration/curve/credit exposure; compensation comparison; instrument choice and invalidation.
skills.exampleEn: Compare a government bond and high-yield credit bond at similar maturities, showing yield, duration, default, liquidity and convexity compensation.
skills.notesEn: A stylized framework curated by Questflow/Bob Xu, not an official skill published or endorsed by the named investor. Verify claims against primary sources.

skills.name: 科技股财报深度拆解与多视角备忘录
skills.summary: 以关键价值驱动因素优先组织16项科技公司财报分析模块，结合六种投资视角、证据分层、反偏差和明确的行动/失效框架。
skills.author: Ruby (Rubywang) and Star (starzq)
skills.environment: 面向能执行联网检索的agent；README标注多工具兼容，但未逐宿主验证。
dependencies: 联网查SEC 10-K/10-Q/8-K、代理声明、业绩会及客户/员工等公开来源；图表或文档产出可能需Python/办公工具，但SKILL未给出固定依赖清单。
inputs: 公司、最新季/年报、市场和估值数据、关键产品/客户/竞争资料、用户持仓背景（如谈行动）。
outputs: 关键驱动因素、16模块分析、多投资哲学比较、估值矩阵、风险/证伪点、行动价格及监控清单。
skills.example: 用SEC申报、管理层纪要和客户资料拆解一家大型科技公司的季度业绩，指出市场预期差、估值支撑、关键失效条件。
skills.method: 先提炼1–3项决定估值的力量，再按力量深挖16模块；用六种投资哲学交叉审视同一证据，并执行反偏差、Pre-Mortem、估值和行动触发框架。
skills.notes: 仓库作者提供的研究框架，不代表提及的投资者观点。技能包含可执行仓位和交易语言；输出仍需最新数据、用户授权及实盘规则核验。
evidenceQuotes: First identify 1-3 decisive forces, then prioritize the 16 modules around those forces
Never fabricate citations. If the exact quote cannot be found, paraphrase and note the source.
skills.nameEn: Tech earnings deep dive and multi-perspective memo
skills.summaryEn: Prioritizes 16 technology-company earnings modules around the key value drivers, combines six investing perspectives, tiered evidence, anti-bias checks and explicit action/invalidation criteria.
skills.methodEn: Identify one to three decisive forces, prioritize the 16 modules around them, compare six investment philosophies on the same evidence, and apply anti-bias, pre-mortem, valuation and action-trigger reviews.
skills.environmentEn: For agents with web-search capability; host compatibility has not been tested.
dependenciesEn: Requires web research across SEC filings, earnings calls and public customer/employee sources. Charts or documents may need Python or office tools; the skill does not specify a fixed dependency list.
inputsEn: Company; latest quarter/year filings; market and valuation data; products, customers and competitors; portfolio context if action is discussed.
outputsEn: Key drivers; 16-module analysis; philosophy comparison; valuation matrix; risks and invalidation; action levels and monitoring list.
skills.exampleEn: Analyze a large technology company’s quarter from SEC filings, management commentary and customer evidence; identify the expectations gap, valuation support and invalidation conditions.
skills.notesEn: A research framework from the repository authors, not the named investors. It includes position/action language; current data, user authorization and live-position rules still need separate verification.

skills.name: 美股长期价值四维分析
skills.summary: 按ROE持续性、债务安全、自由现金流质量和经济护城河四项框架分析美股公司，给出分项评分和投资判断理由。
skills.author: Ruby (Rubywang) and Star (starzq)
skills.environment: 面向能够联网搜索的agent；SKILL要求web_search，其他宿主兼容性未实测。
dependencies: 需联网获取公司最新报表和当前股价；无API密钥或代码依赖声明。
inputs: 美股代码；近3年财务报表；当前股价；行业；竞争优势资料。
outputs: 四项评分、债务/现金流/护城河判断、估值与风险说明、来源链接。
skills.example: 分析一家美国软件公司的三年ROE、债务/资产、FCF/净利润和客户转换成本，逐项评分并说明例外。
skills.method: 对ROE连续性、债务安全、自由现金流质量和护城河评分；对杠杆、回购、银行/REIT行业及周期性进行调整。
skills.notes: 这是仓库作者的教学型框架，不是Buffett官方方法或背书；技能包含阈值型评分，应结合行业和当前数据，不可机械使用。
evidenceQuotes: maintained a high level **consistently for 3+ years**
For banks, Tier 1 Capital Ratio is more appropriate
skills.summaryEn: Assesses US-listed companies across ROE sustainability, debt safety, free-cash-flow quality and economic moat, with dimension scores and a reasoned rating.
skills.methodEn: Score the consistency of ROE, debt safety, free-cash-flow conversion and moat, adjusting for leverage, buybacks, banks/REITs and cyclicality.
skills.environmentEn: For agents with web-search capability; host compatibility has not been tested.
dependenciesEn: Requires web access to current filings and share price. No API key or code dependency is specified.
inputsEn: US ticker; three years of statements; current price; industry; evidence about competitive advantages.
outputsEn: Four dimension scores; debt/cash-flow/moat analysis; valuation and risks; source links.
skills.exampleEn: Review a US software company’s three-year ROE, debt/assets, FCF/net income and customer switching costs, explaining scores and exceptions.
skills.notesEn: An educational framework by repository authors, not an official Buffett method or endorsement. Thresholds need sector and current-data context.

skills.name: 美国股市情绪与仓位风险监测
skills.summary: 跟踪NAAIM主动管理人敞口、机构权益配置、散户净买入、标普500远期PE和对冲基金杠杆五项指标，汇总风险警报并给出中期情绪判断。
skills.author: Ruby (Rubywang) and Star (starzq)
skills.environment: 面向能联网搜索的agent；需逐来源核实，未实测。
dependencies: 联网搜索每周或每日数据；部分机构仓位和对冲基金杠杆并非实时公开，可能需新闻/研究报告；无代码/API依赖声明。
inputs: 评估日期；五个指标可用的最新值、日期、来源及历史区间。
outputs: 五指标状态、警报数、贪婪/中性/恐慌判断、仓位风险提示和来源链接。
skills.example: 每周整理五项美国市场情绪指标，缺少对冲基金杠杆可靠数据时标记缺失，不用估值猜测替代。
skills.method: 检索五个指标并依技能阈值逐一评级，计数形成汇总；数据无法找到时报告最近可用值及日期，并附主要来源。
skills.notes: 高价值数据可能滞后或不公开，尤其基金杠杆和机构配置。技能中的减仓百分比属于框架建议，不构成交易授权。
evidenceQuotes: Some data (such as hedge fund leverage) is not publicly available in real time and may require citing news reports or research publications
If reliable data for an indicator cannot be found, honestly state so rather than guessing
skills.nameEn: US equity sentiment and positioning monitor
skills.summaryEn: Tracks NAAIM exposure, institutional equity allocation, retail net buying, S&P 500 forward P/E and hedge-fund leverage, then summarizes alerts and medium-term sentiment risk.
skills.methodEn: Search for the latest dated readings, rate each indicator using the skill’s thresholds, count warnings and link primary sources. If a reading is unavailable, report that rather than guessing.
skills.environmentEn: For agents with web-search capability; host compatibility has not been tested.
dependenciesEn: Requires network research. Some institutional positioning and hedge-fund leverage data are delayed, non-public in real time or available only through research/news. No code dependency is specified.
inputsEn: As-of date; latest available value, date, source and history for each of the five indicators.
outputsEn: Five indicator statuses; alert count; greed/neutral/panic view; positioning risk notes and source links.
skills.exampleEn: Prepare a weekly five-indicator US sentiment report and mark hedge-fund leverage as unavailable if no reliable dated source exists.
skills.notesEn: Some inputs are delayed or not publicly available. Suggested position changes are framework outputs, not trading authorization.

skills.name: 全球流动性与风险预警
skills.summary: 以Fed净流动性、SOFR、MOVE和日元套利交易四组指标观察全球金融条件，按预先阈值计警报，并注明数据日期和中期适用边界。
skills.author: Ruby (Rubywang) and Star (starzq)
skills.environment: 面向能联网搜索的agent；需跨Fed、财政部、纽约联储、BOJ及行情来源检索。
dependencies: 需联网；Fed资产、TGA、ON RRP、SOFR和汇率利差为公开数据，MOVE可能需金融平台；技能无API密钥或代码包声明。
inputs: 评估日；Fed资产、TGA、ON RRP；SOFR和政策区间；MOVE；USDJPY和美日2年利差；未来事件日历。
outputs: 净流动性计算、四指标状态、警报数、风险响应和源链接。
skills.example: 做周度流动性检查，分别核实Fed总资产、TGA、ON RRP后计算净流动性，再核对SOFR、MOVE与美日利差。
skills.method: 分别检索四组指标，按周变动、SOFR相对政策区间、MOVE水平和日元/利差变化判断警报；汇总等级并对缺失值使用最近日期。
skills.notes: MOVE等市场指标可能需要付费数据渠道。净流动性只是影响风险资产的因素之一，技能说明更适合周/月频趋势而非日内决策。
evidenceQuotes: Net Liquidity = Fed Total Assets - TGA Balance - ON RRP Balance
The three components of net liquidity need to be searched separately; the New York Fed and Treasury websites usually have the latest data
skills.summaryEn: Uses Fed net liquidity, SOFR, MOVE and yen-carry signals to monitor financial conditions. Applies stated alert thresholds and reports as-of dates and medium-term limits.
skills.methodEn: Retrieve each indicator separately, calculate net liquidity, apply weekly-change/rate/MOVE/FX-spread thresholds and summarize alerts. Record dates and use the latest dated value when current data is unavailable.
skills.environmentEn: For agents with web-search capability; host compatibility has not been tested.
dependenciesEn: Requires network research across the Fed, Treasury, New York Fed, Bank of Japan and market data sources. MOVE may require a financial platform. No code or API-key dependency is specified.
inputsEn: As-of date; Fed assets, TGA and ON RRP; SOFR and policy range; MOVE; USDJPY and US-Japan two-year spread; upcoming event calendar.
outputsEn: Net-liquidity calculation; four indicator statuses; alert count; risk responses and source links.
skills.exampleEn: Run a weekly liquidity check by separately verifying Fed assets, TGA and ON RRP, then review SOFR, MOVE and the US-Japan spread.
skills.notesEn: MOVE may require a paid data channel. Liquidity is only one market driver; the skill says the framework suits weekly/monthly monitoring, not intraday decisions.

skills.method: 五步流程：(1) 定义搜索标准（方向、市值、行业、风格、地域、主题）；(2) 按风格运行量化筛选（价值、成长、质量、做空、特殊情形各有明确指标阈值）；(3) 主题扫描：定义论点、绘制价值链、区分纯正/多元敞口、评估定价程度、寻找二阶受益者；(4) 以指标对比表加3-5条论点要点、关键风险与后续步骤呈现每个想法；(5) 输出5-10个想法的短名单、筛选方法论、对比表与优先级排序。
skills.environmentEn: Claude conversational environment; requires user-supplied screening parameters; actual financial data must come from external sources — the file itself provides no data-retrieval tooling.
skills.example: 输入：寻找AI基础设施主题下的全球大盘中长仓想法。流程运行成长与质量筛选（营收增速>15%、ROIC>15%等），绘制AI基础设施价值链，评估哪些公司已定价，输出5-10个想法的一页纸摘要与优先研究排序。
outputsEn: One-page summaries of 5-10 ideas
Documented screening criteria and methodology
Comparison table across ideas
Prioritized list of which ideas to research first
dependencies: 用户提供的筛选参数
外部市场与财务数据（文件未内置）
skills.summaryEn: A systematic stock screening and idea generation workflow combining quantitative screens, thematic sweeps, and contrarian checks to produce long/short candidate shortlists with one-page summaries.
skills.notes: 此条目经来源核对但执行未验证：筛选阈值取自文件原文，数据完整性、市场有效性及想法盈利率均无保证。文件本身声明'筛选只是候选，不是结论'。
inputsEn: Direction (long/short/both)
Market cap and sector scope
Style (value/growth/quality/special situation)
Geography and thematic angle
inputs: 方向（长/短/两者）
市值与行业范围
投资风格（价值/成长/质量/特殊情形）
地域与主题角度
skills.summary: 系统性股票筛选与投资想法生成流程，结合量化筛选、主题研究与逆向思维，产出长/短仓候选清单及一页纸摘要。
skills.notesEn: Source-checked but execution-unverified: screening thresholds are quoted from the file; no guarantee of data completeness, market validity, or idea hit rates. The file itself states screens surface candidates, not conclusions.
evidenceQuotes: Screens surface candidates, not conclusions — every screen output needs fundamental work
Shortlist of 5-10 ideas with one-page summaries
skills.name: 选股想法生成工作流
dependenciesEn: External market and financial data (not built into the file)
outputs: 5-10个想法的一页纸摘要
筛选标准与方法论记录
跨想法对比表
优先研究排序
skills.exampleEn: Input: find global large-cap long ideas on the AI infrastructure theme. The workflow runs growth and quality screens (e.g., revenue growth >15%, ROIC >15%), maps the AI infrastructure value chain, assesses what is already priced in, and outputs 5-10 one-page idea summaries with a prioritized research order.
skills.environment: Claude对话环境；需要使用者提供筛选参数；实际财务数据需外部来源支持，文件本身不包含数据获取工具。
skills.methodEn: Five steps: (1) define search criteria (direction, market cap, sector, style, geography, theme); (2) run style-based quantitative screens with explicit metric thresholds (value, growth, quality, short, special situations); (3) thematic sweep — define thesis, map the value chain, distinguish pure-play vs diversified exposure, assess what is priced in, find second-order beneficiaries; (4) present each idea with a peer comparison table, 3-5 thesis bullets, key risks and next steps; (5) output a 5-10 idea shortlist, documented methodology, comparison table and prioritized list.
skills.author: anthropics

skills.method: 六步流程：(1) 确定更新触发类型（财报、指引变化、假设修正、宏观变化、事件驱动）；(2) 将新实际数据填入模型，包括分部收入与利润率、资产负债表、现金流、股本变动；(3) 调整前瞻预测并记录关键假设变化及原因；(4) 用更新后的预测重算DCF、P/E、EV/EBITDA估值与目标价；(5) 撰写估计变化摘要，判断是改变投资论点还是噪音；(6) 输出更新模型与目标价推导。
skills.environmentEn: Requires the user's analytical environment; can update an existing Excel model if provided.
skills.example: 某公司发布Q3财报后：将营收、毛利率、EBITDA、EPS实际值与此前估计逐项对比填入偏差表，更新分部数据与股本，将下年营收增速假设从8%下调至6%（因管理层指引下调），重算DCF与NTM P/E得出新目标价，并总结该季度是信号还是噪音、相对市场一致预期的差异。
outputsEn: Estimate change table (old estimate, actual, delta)
Revised forward estimates with documented assumption changes
Updated valuation and price target derivation
Estimate change summary
dependencies: Excel/电子表格工具（用户提供模型时）
公司披露的财报数据
skills.summaryEn: Systematically update financial models after earnings, guidance changes, or macro shifts: plug in actuals, revise forward estimates, recalculate valuation, and flag material changes.
skills.notes: 此条目经来源核查，执行未验证。局限：无内置市场数据访问，需用户提供实际数据与现有模型；估值倍数与假设由分析师自行设定。示例仅使用公开、非敏感输入。
inputsEn: Quarterly earnings actuals
Existing Excel financial model
Management guidance
Updated macro assumptions (rates, FX, commodities)
inputs: 季度财报实际数据
现有Excel财务模型
管理层指引
更新后的宏观假设（利率、汇率、商品价格）
skills.summary: 在财报、指引变化或宏观假设变动后，系统化更新财务模型：填入实际数据、修正前瞻预测、重算估值并标注重大变化。
skills.notesEn: Source-checked, execution-unverified. Limits: no built-in market data access; users must supply actuals and the existing model. Valuation multiples and assumptions are set by the analyst. Examples use public, non-sensitive inputs only.
evidenceQuotes: Update financial models with new data — quarterly earnings, management guidance, macro changes, or revised assumptions. Adjusts estimates, recalculates valuation, and flags material changes.
Always reconcile your estimates to the company's reported figures before projecting forward
skills.name: 财报后财务模型更新
dependenciesEn: Excel/spreadsheet tool (when user provides a model)
outputs: 估计变化对比表（旧估计、实际值、偏差）
修正后的前瞻预测及假设变化说明
更新后的估值与目标价推导
估计变化摘要
skills.exampleEn: After a company releases Q3 results: compare revenue, gross margin, EBITDA, and EPS actuals vs. prior estimates in a delta table, update segment data and share count, cut next-year revenue growth assumption from 8% to 6% due to lowered guidance, recompute DCF and NTM P/E for a new price target, and summarize signal vs. noise and positioning vs. Street consensus.
skills.environment: 需要用户的分析环境；若提供现有Excel模型则可直接更新。
skills.methodEn: Six steps: (1) identify update trigger (earnings, guidance change, assumption revision, macro, event-driven); (2) plug in new actuals including segment detail, balance sheet, cash flow, and share count; (3) revise forward estimates and document key assumption changes with reasons; (4) recalculate DCF, P/E, EV/EBITDA valuation and price target; (5) write an estimate-change summary judging whether it is thesis-changing or noise; (6) output updated model and price target derivation.

evidenceQuotes: Audit a spreadsheet for formula accuracy, errors, and common mistakes. Scopes to a selected range, a single sheet, or the entire model
Cash tie-out | CF Ending Cash = BS Cash (every period)
Hardcoded overrides are the #1 source of silent bugs
inputsEn: Spreadsheet workbook (selection, sheet, or full financial model)

skills.methodEn: 1) Determine scope (selection/sheet/model); ask if not given. 2) All scopes: formula-level checks for #REF!/#VALUE! errors, hardcodes inside formulas, inconsistent formulas, off-by-one ranges, pasted-over formulas, circular references, broken cross-sheet links, unit/scale mismatches, hidden rows/tabs. 3) Model scope: structural review (input/formula separation, color convention, tab flow, date and unit consistency); balance sheet balance and RE rollforward; cash flow tie-outs (ending cash = BS cash, CFO+CFI+CFF = delta cash, D&A and CapEx matches); income statement checks; circular reference classification; logic/reasonableness flags (growth, margins, terminal value dominance, edge cases); model-type-specific bug lists (DCF discounting period conventions, LBO sweep/PIK mechanics, merger share counts and PPA, 3-statement working capital signs). 4) Output a findings table (location, severity, category, suggested fix) with a summary line for model scope; report first, fix only on request.

skills.method: 五阶段流程：(1) 备份原模板，从各来源提取数据并对照原始文件校验数字、统一单位与货币；(2) 审阅模板结构，将来源数据映射到对应版块，识别占位指引框并记录数据缺口；(3) 删除彩色指引框、按模板风格填充内容，表格必须为真实表格对象而非竖线/制表符文本，箭头为 PowerPoint 形状；(4) 用 soffice 转 PDF 再转图片做逐页校验清单（对比度、表格对象、字号一致、无越界、跨页数字一致），最多三个修复循环后升级给用户；(5) 交付前核对数据准确性、引用脚注与模板合规清单。计算值按 CAGR、共识等标准公式复核；LibreOffice 渲染局限需在交付时声明并建议在 Microsoft PowerPoint 中复核。
skills.exampleEn: A user provides a blank TAM pitch deck template for a tech company plus an Excel with market size, CAGR, and transaction comps data: back up the pptx, verify the Excel figures against source reports, map market definition, TAM sizing, and comps slides to template sections, delete yellow instruction boxes, populate data as real table objects, validate font sizes and cross-slide consistency via rendered images, then deliver with the LibreOffice validation disclaimer.
outputsEn: Populated, template-compliant pitch deck .pptx file
Source footnotes plus validation and fix documentation
List of data gaps and unresolved issues (e.g., missing logo)
dependencies: LibreOffice (soffice)
pdftoppm (Poppler)

skills.methodEn: Five phases: (1) back up the original template, extract data from each source, validate figures against originals, standardize units and currency; (2) review template structure, map source data to sections, identify placeholder instruction boxes, and note data gaps; (3) remove colored instruction boxes and populate content per template style, with tables as actual table objects (never pipe/tab-separated text) and arrows as PowerPoint shapes; (4) validate each slide via soffice-to-PDF-to-image checks (contrast, table objects, font consistency, boundaries, cross-slide figure consistency) in up to three fix cycles before escalation; (5) run final checklists on data accuracy, citations/footnotes, and template compliance. Calculations are verified against CAGR and consensus formula standards; the LibreOffice rendering limitation must be disclosed and PowerPoint review recommended.

Key caveats: purchases by heavily pledged shareholders may defend pledge margin lines; policy-encouraged 'stabilization' buying is a weaker signal than voluntary buying; signal strength ranks buying > buybacks > mere plans; sales have varied motives and are not automatically bearish; cluster buying outweighs single-buyer buying. Output is informational, not investment advice; the skill is source-reviewed but execution-unverified.
skills.method: 五步工作流：确认分析范围（行业、时间窗口默认90天、结果数量默认前5家、交易主体、板块）→ 按集群增持（≥2名内部人）、交易方式（仅二级市场竞价或大宗买入，排除股权激励行权与定增）、时效性、显著性、股权质押筛选 → 按增持人职务层级、金额绝对值、占年薪比例、逆势买入、增持密度、主动vs政策驱动排名评分 → 对头部公司逐家深度分析（谁在增持、历史效果、信心解读、风险信号）→ 输出含摘要、方法论、个股分析、对比表与风险提示的结构化报告。
outputs: 符合条件的集群增持公司排名评分列表
前5家公司逐家深度分析
含摘要、方法论、个股分析、对比表、风险提示的结构化报告

skills.environment: 对话式分析环境；需A股董监高增减持披露数据。实时行情、财务指标、增减持记录等可借助金融数据工具包技能（findata-toolkit-cn），所有数据源免费且无需API密钥。
outputsEn: Ranked and scored list of companies with qualifying cluster buying
Per-company deep dives for the top five
Structured report with summary, methodology, company analyses, comparison table, and risk caveats
skills.exampleEn: User asks: which A-share companies saw clustered insider buying in the past 90 days? Workflow: scan the whole market over 90 days, filter for at least two insiders making voluntary open-market purchases while excluding purchases by heavily pledged shareholders, score by buyer seniority and amount, take the top five, and for each report buyer names/roles, amounts and dates, historical post-buying price performance, plus pledge or policy-driven risk caveats.

A股董监高及重要股东增减持披露数据（姓名、职务、股数、金额、日期）

skills.methodEn: Five-step workflow: confirm scope (industry, default 90-day window, top-5 results, insider type, board segment) -> screen for cluster buying (>=2 insiders), genuine open-market or block purchases (excluding option exercises and private placements), recency, materiality, and pledge status -> rank on buyer seniority, absolute amount, ratio to salary, counter-trend timing, buying density, and voluntary vs policy-driven nature -> deep-dive top companies (who bought, historical follow-through, confidence interpretation, risk signals) -> deliver a structured report with summary, methodology, company analyses, comparison table, and risk caveats.

skills.summaryEn: Diagnoses risk and inefficiency in an existing portfolio, covering concentration, correlation clusters, factor exposures, risk metrics, historical scenario stress tests, and liquidity, then produces a health score and prioritized improvement recommendations.
skills.notesEn: Positioned as diagnosis rather than building a portfolio from scratch (use a risk-adjusted return optimizer for that). Emphasizes context dependence (100% equity may suit a young long-horizon investor), no A-share capital gains tax, price-limit liquidity effects, dividend-tax holding periods, behavioral sensitivity, and a non-personalized-advice disclaimer. Incomplete user data must be clarified; real-time data depends on the external data toolkit. This entry is source-reviewed but execution-unverified.
skills.method: 按八个步骤工作：导入并归一化持仓为百分比权重；多维度集中度分析（个股、前五大、申万行业、市场、市值、资产类别、风格，各有红灯阈值）；两两相关系数检测相关性聚集（3只以上平均两两相关>0.7）与有效分散比率；因子暴露分解（Beta、价值、成长、规模、动量、质量、波动率、股息率）并标记偏离基准超1个标准差的暴露；计算波动率、Beta、跟踪误差、主动份额、VaR/CVaR、最大回撤与夏普/索提诺估计；以2015股灾、2018贸易摩擦、2020疫情、2022调整、2008金融危机等历史情景做压力测试；按日均成交量20%估算变现天数评估流动性；综合为健康评分、严重问题、警示事项、优势、改进建议与调仓方案。

skills.methodEn: An eight-step workflow: import and normalize holdings to percentage weights; multi-dimensional concentration analysis (single stock, top five, SW industry, market, size band, asset class, style, each with red-line thresholds); pairwise correlation cluster detection (three or more holdings averaging pairwise correlation above 0.7) plus effective diversification ratio; factor exposure decomposition (Beta, value, growth, size, momentum, quality, volatility, dividend yield) flagging deviations beyond one standard deviation vs benchmark; portfolio metrics (volatility, Beta, tracking error, active share, VaR/CVaR, max drawdown, Sharpe/Sortino estimates); stress testing against 2015 crash, 2018 trade friction, 2020 pandemic, 2022 adjustment, and 2008 financial crisis scenarios; liquidity assessment via liquidation days at 20% of average daily volume; and a synthesis into health score, critical issues, warnings, strengths, prioritized recommendations, and rebalancing plan.

skills.summaryEn: A read-only workflow using the tdl CLI to list Telegram chats and channels, find a channel by name, and export recent messages or a date/ID range for financial news and market research, with results grouped by theme (macro, earnings, crypto).
skills.method: 先检测 tdl 是否安装并验证会话（tdl chat ls --limit 1）；如未认证则引导用户以 QR 码或手机+验证码交互登录。随后匹配读取操作：用 tdl chat ls（可加过滤器）列出或搜索频道，用 tdl chat export 配合 -T last/time/id 与 --all --with-content 导出消息到 JSON 文件，读取文件提取 id、date、message、views 等字段，最后按时间戳与来源频道归纳最相关的新闻与市场更新。

skills.notesEn: Read-only: cannot send messages or join/leave channels. Credentials must be entered interactively by the user; never handle passwords or 2FA programmatically. On FLOOD_WAIT_X wait the indicated seconds; CHANNEL_PRIVATE means the user must join the channel in their app first. This skill is source-checked but execution-unverified; failed access or missing data must be stated as an explicit data gap, not treated as no material events or no risk.
skills.notes: 只读：不支持发送消息、加入或退出频道。登录凭据须由用户交互输入，不得程序化处理密码或 2FA。遭遇 FLOOD_WAIT_X 需等待；CHANNEL_PRIVATE 表示用户需先在 Telegram 应用中加入频道。本技能经过来源核验，但未经验证执行；若无法访问频道或数据缺失，应明确说明为数据缺口，不得视为无重大事件或无风险。
skills.exampleEn: Export the last 20 messages of a channel: tdl chat export -c @channel_name -T last -i 20 --all --with-content -o /tmp/tdl-export.json, then read the JSON, group messages by macro, earnings, and crypto themes, and call out breaking news, price targets, and earnings surprises with timestamps and source channels.
